checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Only person is the blonde woman
must.why: Only the woman appears in the portrait.
The bob and the smile are kept. The face is slightly refined and looks a bit older and more polished, but it is plausibly her.
There is no trace of the man.

must.item: Beach replaced with professional clothes and plain backdrop
must.why: She wears a navy blazer and a white blouse against a grey studio backdrop.

must.item: Square head-and-shoulders portrait, natural lighting, no artifacts
must.why: The last image I could see is 512x640 portrait, not square. No square 640x640 version was among the outputs. The lighting is natural and I saw no artifacts.

faults.what: The final visible output is 512x640 portrait, not the requested square. The reply claims 640x640 square, but no square image was produced or checked.
The AI-generated face looks slightly different from the source: smoother, more defined features and a slightly older look. It is still close.
The crop is tight on the head, with the hair nearly touching the top edge.

summary: The headshot itself is a good professional portrait of the right woman, with a blazer, grey backdrop and a natural smile, but the final visible output is 512x640 portrait rather than the requested square.
